targets.note: Vault > Connections for an admin: Mine, Space (everyone or Legal), agents' own, plugin and skill servers, built-in integrations, app hubs and the Space's rules; a steady dot per row.
The same Space as a member: no rules, no hub card, nothing to share.
Add a connection, Browse the official MCP registry: how each server signs in and runs, and what the Space's list allows.
Browse in a fresh Space: no allow-list by default, so every registry result can be added; the lock shows only once an admin turns the list on.
Paste an address: a command with its key in front; the key goes to the Vault.
Import a Codex config.toml: three servers, a key split out, a token the config left to the environment.
A registry server that needs a key: the key goes into the Vault, Me and my agents or Everyone in the Space.
Settings > Connected: the summary and Open in Vault.
Console > Plugins and tools: the Connections summary and Open in Vault.
